description: Lists the insurance products a Danish company can be offered and the questions to answer before quoting. Pass the company's CVR to resolve industry-specific questions and options. Use product slugs in `products` and question names as keys in `answers`. Employee FTE questions are listed as two whole-number questions, `<name>.fullTime` and `<name>.partTime`, each from 0 to 9999 inclusive; when required, send both counts, including zero. Numeric questions publish min/max limits when configured. Products with automaticQuote:false need manual review and list no questions. A product's requiredProducts must be selected with it; its questions include theirs. MultiSelect answers may be left out and default to an empty list. Enum fields use {value, label: {da, en}}; use value for logic and label for display. Read-only: nothing is created. Works without signing in. For an existing customer, call list_companies first and select the company with set_company_context. Use its CVR when collecting questions and quoting.

cvr.description: Danish company registration number (CVR), eight digits, e.g. 39488914.

region.description: Market. Only Denmark (dk) is supported. Optional; defaults to dk.

name: list_onboarding_catalog

outputSchema.description: Products and questions to collect answers for before quoting.

errors.description: Products that are listed but cannot currently be quoted, e.g. pricing_configuration.

allowedValues.description: For invalid_answer on a select question: the option keys that are accepted.

code.description: Error code and its translated labels.

idempotency_conflict.da: Idempotensnøglen er allerede brugt til andre oplysninger
idempotency_conflict.en: Idempotency key already used for different input

didYouMean.description: Suggested catalog product slug or answer key. Retry only after confirming the intended value.

field.description: Request field to correct, using dot notation for nested fields.

max.description: Inclusive maximum: the latest start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for invalid_start_date, or the numeric upper bound for invalid_answer.

min.description: Inclusive minimum: the earliest start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for invalid_start_date, or the numeric lower bound for invalid_answer.

nextAction.description: What to do next: fixAnswer (correct the request and retry), askUser (ask the person for new input or to sign in), retryLater (retry the same request later), contactPlain (Plain must review this case; refer the person to Plain), none (nothing to do).

askUser.da: Bed kunden om oplysninger eller login
askUser.en: Ask the customer for input or to sign in

fixAnswer.en: Correct the request and try again

product.description: Slug of the product the error concerns, when it concerns one.

question.description: Answer key of the question the error concerns, as used in `answers`.

questionLabel.description: Danish question label, when the question can be identified in the catalog.

da.description: Danish question label from the catalog.

reason.description: For price_unavailable: industry_not_covered when the product has no tariff for the company's industry, otherwise unknown.

items.description: A product that can only be bought together with another.

requiredProduct.description: Slug of a product that must be selected together with `product`.

items.description: An insurance product that can be offered to a Danish company.

automaticQuote.description: Whether this product supports an instant quote. False means manual review is required: its questions are not listed and the quote returns contactPlain without answers. True does not guarantee a price for every company or set of answers.

billingFrequency.description: How often the customer pays: Monthly or Annual. Prices are per period of this frequency.

coverage.description: What the insurance covers, in Danish.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of all prices for this product: DKK.

insuranceId.description: Original insurance ID for matching existing content product references. Use the product slug, not this ID, when quoting.

pricePerEmployee.description: Whether the quoted price is per covered employee. The employees are selected when purchasing on Plain, so no question asks for them.

product.description: Product slug. Use it in `products` and to qualify answer keys.

questions.description: Questions to answer for this product, including company-wide questions shared with other products and the questions of its `requiredProducts`. Empty when automaticQuote is false.

items.description: A question for this product and whether its answer is required.

question.description: A question to answer before pricing.

max.description: Inclusive maximum numeric answer, when configured. Employee counts have a maximum of 9999.

min.description: Inclusive minimum numeric answer, when configured. Employee counts have a minimum of 0.

name.description: Answer key: use it as the key in `answers`.

options.description: Available options in display order. Omitted when there are none. Answer with `value`, not the label.

label.description: Localized option label. Currently only Danish is available.

da.description: Danish option label from the backend.

value.description: Option value to send as the answer.

period.description: Answer period from the question's period setting, when configured.

step.description: Suggested numeric input increment, when configured. Employee counts use 1 (whole numbers).

title.description: The question as shown to the customer, in Danish.

type.description: Answer type: Text, NumberWhole (integer), NumberDecimal, Date (YYYY-MM-DD), Boolean, Select (one key of `options`) or MultiSelect (array of keys).

unit.description: Answer unit from the question's unit setting, when configured.

required.description: Whether the product cannot be priced without this answer.

requiredProducts.description: Products that must be selected together with this one, directly or indirectly. Add them to `products` when quoting.

ipidPdf.description: Insurance product information document (IPID) as PDF. Give this link to the customer.

ipidYaml.description: The IPID as YAML, for agents to read the key facts: what is and is not covered, restrictions and obligations.

termsMarkdown.description: Full insurance terms as Markdown, for agents to read and answer questions about coverage.

termsPdf.description: Full insurance terms as PDF. Give this link to the customer.

termsDocuments.description: Links to the product's terms documents, or null when it has none. Read the YAML and Markdown to answer questions; give the customer the PDF links. External terms use the same link for all four.

termsUrl.description: Link to the full insurance terms as PDF. Same as `termsDocuments.termsPdf`.
